## Activity

Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 58 captures during November 2021. This activity provides the basis for reviewing throughput, image quality and grading outcomes for the reporting period. The recorded activity should be considered alongside the quality and grading information below, so that operational issues can be identified and addressed promptly.

## Image quality

Of the 58 captures, 4 were recorded as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 6.9. This indicates that a small proportion of captures could not be used for grading and may require attention to the image acquisition process. Recurring camera issues should continue to be logged with the service desk, with sufficient information to support investigation and follow-up.

## Grading

A total of 10 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 8. This measure should be monitored with activity and image quality results to support timely review of service performance. The clinic lead should ensure that recurring camera issues are reported through the service desk and that relevant operational concerns are followed through to resolution.
